int nod(int a, int b) {
    while (b != 0) {
        int r = a % b;
        a = b;
        b = r;
    }
    return a;
}

fraction reduce_fraction(int x, int y) {
    int g = nod(x, y);
    return make_pair((ll)(x / g), (ll)(y / g));
}

fraction search_best(int x, int y, int n) {
    ld best = 1000050000.;
    ld target = (ld)x / y;
    fraction best_frac;

    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        ld value = (ld)x * i / y;

        ld low = floorl(value);
        ld error = std::abs(low / i - target);
        if (error < best) {
            best_frac = make_pair((ll)low, (ll)i);
            best = error;
        }

        ld high = ceill(value);
        error = std::abs(high / i - target);
        if (error < best) {
            best_frac = make_pair((ll)high, (ll)i);
            best = error;
        }
    }

    return best_frac;
}

fraction solve(int x, int y, int n) {
    if (n >= y) return reduce_fraction(x, y);
    return search_best(x, y, n);
}

int main() {
#ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
#define cin fin
    ifstream fin("omg.txt");
#endif
    int x, y, n;
    cin >> x >> y >> n;

    fraction ans = solve(x, y, n);
